evidence.ACL: there is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: there is buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn.
evidence.Medial OA: There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.Lateral OA: There is focal high grade chondral defect (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posterolateral tibial plateau
evidence.PF OA: the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion
evidence.Effusion: Some amount of left knee effusion is present.
evidence.Contusion: There is no fracture or bone contusion.
evidence.Fracture: There is no fracture or bone contusion.
